description: Confirm ATG9B positional equivalence and plot cross-cargo motif comparison against composition-matched expectation
code:
import requests, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session()
def seqof(x): return S.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{x}.json",timeout=60).json()['sequence']['value']
A=seqof("Q7Z3C6"); B=seqof("Q674R7")
groups=["AGST","ILMV","FWY","DE","KRH","NQ","CP"]
sim={}
for g in groups:
    for x in g:
        for y in g: sim[(x,y)]=1
def sw(a,b,go=-11,ge=-1,match=4,mism=-3):
    def sc(x,y): return match if x==y else (1 if sim.get((x,y)) else mism)
    n,m=len(a),len(b)
    H=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); E=np.full((n+1,m+1),-1e9); F=np.full((n+1,m+1),-1e9); TB=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    best=(0,0,0)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            E[i,j]=max(E[i,j-1]+ge,H[i,j-1]+go); F[i,j]=max(F[i-1,j]+ge,H[i-1,j]+go)
            d=H[i-1,j-1]+sc(a[i-1],b[j-1]); v=max(0,d,E[i,j],F[i,j]); H[i,j]=v
            TB[i,j]=0 if v==0 else (1 if v==d else (2 if v==E[i,j] else 3))
            if v>best[0]: best=(v,i,j)
    v,i,j=best; A1=[];B1=[];M=[]
    while i>0 and j>0 and H[i,j]>0:
        t=TB[i,j]
        if t==1:
            A1.append(a[i-1]);B1.append(b[j-1]);M.append("|" if a[i-1]==b[j-1] else (":" if sim.get((a[i-1],b[j-1])) else " "));i-=1;j-=1
        elif t==2: A1.append("-");B1.append(b[j-1]);M.append(" ");j-=1
        else: A1.append(a[i-1]);B1.append("-");M.append(" ");i-=1
    return v,i+1,j+1,''.join(reversed(A1)),''.join(reversed(M)),''.join(reversed(B1))

v,ia,ib,a1,mid,b1=sw(A[0:34], B[139:185])
print("SW: ATG9A 1-34 vs ATG9B 140-185")
print(f"  score={v:.0f}")
print(f"  ATG9A {ia:>3} {a1}")
print(f"         {' '*3} {mid}")
print(f"  ATG9B {139+ib:>3} {b1}")
print("\nconclusion: ATG9A YQRLE(8-12) is positionally equivalent to ATG9B YERLE(151-155)")

# ---------------- figure ----------------
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,8.5),gridspec_kw={"height_ratios":[1.15,1]})
ax=axes[0]; ax.axis("off")
rows=[("ATG9A  (AP-4 cargo, PMID 29180427)",  "AQFDTE","YQRLE","ASYSDS","#2171b5"),
      ("APP    (AP-4 cargo, PMID 20230749)",  "GYENPT","YKFFE","QMQN  ","#2171b5"),
      ("TGOLN2/TGN46 (AP-1 / AP-2 cargo)",    "RPKASD","YQRLD","QKS   ","#d7301f"),
      ("ATG9B  (positional equivalent, not a reported cargo)","IPEQD","YERLE","DCDPEG","#777777"),
      ("SERINC1 (AP-4 cargo, 147 aa cytosolic)","  no Yxx","  -  ","bulky+acidic motif","#777777"),
      ("SERINC3 (AP-4 cargo, 126 aa cytosolic)","  no Yxx","  -  ","bulky+acidic motif","#777777"),
      ("SERINC5 (AP-4 cargo, 103 aa cytosolic)","  no Yxx","  -  ","bulky+acidic motif","#777777")]
for k,(lab,pre,mot,post,col) in enumerate(rows):
    y=len(rows)-k
    ax.text(0.0,y,lab,fontsize=10,va="center")
    ax.text(0.47,y,pre,family="monospace",fontsize=12,va="center",color="#555555")
    ax.text(0.60,y,mot,family="monospace",fontsize=14,va="center",color=col,fontweight="bold")
    ax.text(0.70,y,post,family="monospace",fontsize=12,va="center",color="#555555")
ax.set_xlim(-0.02,1.0); ax.set_ylim(0.2,len(rows)+1.1)
ax.set_title("a  The ATG9A signal is as similar to the canonical TGN46 YQRL signal as it is to the APP YKFFE signal,\n"
             "and the other AP-4 cargoes (SERINC1/3/5) carry no motif of this class at all",fontsize=11,loc="left")

ax=axes[1]
labs=["ATG9A","APP","SERINC1","SERINC3","SERINC5","ATG9B","TGOLN2","CD4"]
obs=[1,1,0,0,0,2,1,0]; exp=[0.71,0.10,0.09,0.06,0.19,0.28,0.02,0.00]
x=np.arange(len(labs)); w=0.38
ax.bar(x-w/2,obs,w,label="observed Yxx[bulky][DE] in cytosolic domain",color="#2171b5")
ax.bar(x+w/2,exp,w,label="expected from amino-acid composition",color="#bdbdbd")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(labs); ax.set_ylabel("motif count")
ax.legend(fontsize=9,frameon=False)
ax.set_title("b  Occurrence of the motif pattern is close to the composition-matched expectation, so pattern presence alone\n"
             "carries little information: position, disorder and conservation do the discriminating work",fontsize=11,loc="left")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
